entities.name: knowledge graphs

relationships.description: GraphRAG emerges as an innovative solution to address the challenges and limitations of traditional RAG.
GraphRAG retrieves graph elements from a pre-constructed graph database, such as knowledge graphs.
The text states that RAG struggles with tasks such as Query-Focused Summarization, implying it is a task type associated with the method's domain of application (though poorly solved).
